div.head: Af 38.1
div.ab: Gif he folces gemot mid wæpnes bryde arære, þam ealdermen CXX scll'.
Gif he folcgemot mid wæpnes bryde árære, ðam ealdormen hundtwelftig scill. to wite.
Si quis folcgemot (id est populi placitum) armorum exercione turbabit, emendet aldermanno CXX sol. wite (id est forisfacture).
Gif he folcgemot mid wæpnes bryde árære, ðam ealdormen hundtwelftig scill to wite.
If he disrupts the folk meeting by drawing his weapon, 120 shillings to the ealdorman as fine.
If he disturbs the meeting by drawing his weapon, he shall pay a fine of 120 shillings to the ealdorman.
If he disturbs a public meeting by drawing a weapon, [he is to pay] 120 shillings to the ealdorman as a fine.
Wenn er [solche] Volksversammlung durch Waffenzücken [ohne Gefecht] aufregt: jenem Ealdorman 120 Schill. als Strafgeld.
If he stirs up [such] a public assembly by drawing a weapon [without fighting]: 120 shillings to that ealdorman as a fine.

note.label: cf.
note.quote: Alfred §40.1 states that drawing a weapon in a ceorl's house but not using it to fight draws half the fine of a fight.
